value.rationale: These four successive lengths supply the first representative of every residue class modulo four, the periodicity relevant to the motivating bidirected-polygon topology. They quantify a natural minimal bidirected pendant perturbation in full integral homotopy: changes in connectedness, fundamental group and mixed-dimensional higher spheres. As exact initial boundary data for a possible general graph-defect classification, the finite result is mathematically motivated independently of any unproved infinite periodicity.
